planned: 2026-11-04 by the planner, on claude/cool-mayer-ki7to6 at f80d846; revised 21:15-21:40 UTC after the critique (PLAN-5 'Critique log'): seven build roles (backend-flood-live split from backend-flood-bundle-api), re-estimated hours, dependency-based concurrency
notes: At most 2 agents build, review or fix at once (4 CPUs). A free slot goes, in order, to (1) a pending fix, (2) a pending review, (3) the next role whose depends_on roles are built, reviewed and fixed, ties broken by 'order' (PLAN-5 10.3); then integration part 1 once its depends_on are fixed, part 2 when everything is fixed, then final-check. 'waves' is the default order only.

Ownership: any two roles (or integration part 1) that depends_on does not order, directly or through other roles, may run at the same time, so their 'owns' must be disjoint. PLAN-5 appendix A checks every such pair against git ls-files plus 'planned_new'. A path owned by two ordered roles is handed over in order (the later role starts after the earlier one is reviewed and fixed). Roles never edit 'shared_frozen' paths; a needed change goes through the orchestrator. The integration may edit README.md and CONTRACT.md 16.16 only among the frozen paths.

Milestone waits: web-flood-overview imports flood types only after 'brief 5 backend-flood-sources: M1 contracts' is in git log and copies the web fixtures after '...: M2 fixture'. web-flood-public tests manifest loading, startFloodBuild and job polling against the real route after 'brief 5 backend-flood-bundle-api: M2 bundle' (before that, the fixture server's canned build job). web-flood-forensic uses the real build/files routes after '...bundle-api: M2 bundle' and mounts the dock hydrograph after 'brief 5 web-flood-command: M1 hydrograph' (if that is not in git log by Forensic's last milestone, it leaves a placeholder and the integration mounts it). Web roles use backend/scripts/serve_fixture.py until the real routes they need are in git log (PLAN-5 7.2).

Commits: 'brief 5 <role>: M<n> <what>' with a pathspec (git add <own paths>; git commit -m "..." -- <own paths>), ending with the two attribution lines; push after each milestone (git push origin claude/cool-mayer-ki7to6; on rejection git pull --no-rebase origin claude/cool-mayer-ki7to6, then push; on index.lock wait 10 s and retry). Never force-push, never commit data/ or .env.

Each build role writes docs/redesign/progress/brief5-<role>.md, docs/redesign/reports/brief5-<role>.json (summary, files, screenshots, known_issues, cut_line_left, test skip count), docs/redesign/contract5/<role>.md (as-built notes; only the integration edits CONTRACT.md) and docs/screenshots/brief5-<role>-*.png (view every one).

Reviews: one reviewer per build role, two lenses (design and contract fidelity; behaviour and safety), in a clean worktree, on ports 8757/5217 (8758/5218 when two reviews run at once), writing docs/redesign/reports/review5-<role>.json, docs/redesign/progress/review5-<role>.md and docs/screenshots/review5-<role>-*.png. The fixer owns the role's paths and its own ports and commits 'brief 5 <role>: review fixes'.

Gates for every role before its last commit: cd backend && uv run pytest -q; cd web && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build (lint 55 warnings, all in src/scene; add none). Record the pytest skip count in the report; no flood test may skip (the flood tests generate fixture-flood into tmp_path). A gate failure confined to another role's file is recorded and rerun after that role's next commit.

Secrets (override of one CLAUDE.md line, stated in every role prompt): CLAUDE.md still says 'The only secret is FIRMS_MAP_KEY'; the user approved EARTHDATA_TOKEN as a second secret in BRIEF-5 decision 2. Both come only from the environment or .env; never printed, logged, committed or copied; leak scans are count-only. Nobody edits CLAUDE.md (PLAN-5 12 U3). There is no EARTHDATA_TOKEN in the cloud session: the token path is tested with a fake token and a mock transport only.
Ports: never 8000, 8710, 5173, 5180. Stop every server you start. One Chrome at a time per agent; iterate with npx vitest run <files>.
Glob syntax: '*' stays inside one folder, '**' crosses folders, '[!x]' excludes a first character, '[Ff]' matches either case.
